INTRODUCTIONM
In this lesson, you will learn about the astable multivibrator.
Astable multivibrators change the DC operating voltage to a square wave output.
The operation of an astable multivibrator is free-running. It requires no external input pulse.
The components in the feedback circuit determine astable operation.
